ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio with approximately 45% high-intensity white pixels on distal lobes and 55% low-intensity black pixels in the central region.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white regions occupy the outer distal sections of both lobes; the central proximal region and inner lobes are primarily black with high-density circular white mottling.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an estimated angle of 55 degrees and significant pixel-depth relative to the fluke width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serrations along the trailing edge; extreme irregularity and jagged topography localized at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical upward convexity along the trailing edge leading to tapered, irregular lobe tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High density of white circular and ring-shaped pixel clusters (5-15 pixel diameter) concentrated in the dark central and inner-lobe regions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple white linear streaks and parallel rake marks intersecting the dark pigmentation, primarily on the right lobe and central region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive coverage of circular rosette scars and linear rake marks; heavily textured and eroded trailing edges at the distal tips.
